title: Present continuous and present simple (1)
summary: Тонкости выбора между present simple и present continuous: временное и постоянное, меняющиеся ситуации, глаголы состояния и их «действенные» значения, конструкция be being.
ru:
## Повторение в двух словах
Present simple описывает факты, привычки и устойчивые состояния, present continuous — действие «в развитии» или ситуацию, которая воспринимается как временная. На уровне B2 важно другое: очень часто **обе формы грамматически верны**, а выбор зависит от того, как говорящий видит ситуацию.
> My brother lives in Osaka. — Мой брат живёт в Осаке. (это его постоянный дом)
> My brother is living in Osaka. — Мой брат сейчас живёт в Осаке. (пока что; потом, возможно, переедет)

## Временное и постоянное
Present continuous не обязательно означает «прямо сейчас, в эту секунду». Оно охватывает целый период вокруг момента речи — неделю, семестр, год.
> I'm reading a biography of Churchill at the moment, but it isn't in my hands right now. — Я сейчас читаю биографию Черчилля (но книга не у меня в руках).
> The company is hiring engineers this quarter. — В этом квартале компания набирает инженеров.
Когда мы хотим подчеркнуть, что ситуация обычна и неизменна, берём present simple: **The museum opens at nine.** Когда хотим сказать, что сейчас всё не как обычно, — present continuous: **The museum is opening late this week because of the renovation.**

## Меняющиеся и развивающиеся ситуации
Для процессов, которые идут прямо сейчас и меняют картину, используем continuous, часто с глаголами **get, become, grow, rise, fall, increase, improve, change**.
> The climate is changing faster than models predicted. — Климат меняется быстрее, чем предсказывали модели.
> Her English is getting better every week. — Её английский улучшается с каждой неделей.
Сравните: **Water boils at 100 °C** (закон природы, simple) и **The water is boiling — turn the gas down** (процесс сейчас, continuous).

## Глаголы состояния (stative verbs)
Глаголы, описывающие состояние, а не действие, обычно не стоят в continuous: **know, believe, understand, belong, own, owe, need, prefer, mean, doubt, remember, seem, consist**.
- ~~I'm knowing the answer.~~ → I **know** the answer.
- ~~This flat is belonging to my aunt.~~ → This flat **belongs** to my aunt.
Но многие глаголы имеют **два значения**: «состояние» (simple) и «действие» (continuous).
> I **think** it's too risky. — Я считаю, что это слишком рискованно. (мнение)
> I'm **thinking** about moving abroad. — Я обдумываю переезд за границу. (процесс)
> The soup **tastes** salty. — Суп на вкус солёный. / The chef **is tasting** the soup. — Шеф пробует суп.
> She **has** two cars. — У неё две машины. / She **is having** lunch. — Она обедает.
> I **see** your point. — Я понимаю вашу мысль. / I'**m seeing** my dentist on Friday. — Я иду к стоматологу в пятницу.
> The bag **weighs** 20 kilos. / The porter **is weighing** the bag.

## be + being: поведение, а не свойство
С прилагательными, описывающими характер, конструкция **be being** показывает, что человек **ведёт себя** так в данный момент (обычно не так, как всегда).
> He is rude. — Он грубый человек (по натуре).
> He's being rude. — Он сейчас груб (ведёт себя грубо).
> You're being very helpful today. — Ты сегодня необычайно услужлив.
Так можно только с прилагательными, которыми можно управлять: **careful, silly, stubborn, nice, difficult, polite**. С **tall, old, blonde, Irish** конструкция невозможна: ~~She is being tall.~~

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'm not understanding this chapter.~~ → I **don't understand** this chapter.
- ~~What do you think about right now?~~ → What **are you thinking** about right now? (процесс)
- ~~She is liking jazz.~~ → She **likes** jazz.
- ~~Every summer the river is flooding the village.~~ → The river **floods** the village every summer. (повторяющееся)
en:
## A quick reminder
Present simple describes facts, habits and permanent states. Present continuous describes an action in progress or a situation we see as temporary. At B2 level, though, **both forms are often grammatically possible**, and the choice shows how the speaker sees the situation.
> My brother lives in Osaka. (it is his permanent home)
> My brother is living in Osaka. (for now; he may move later)

## Temporary and permanent
Present continuous does not have to mean 'at this very second'. It can cover a longer period around the moment of speaking: a week, a term, a year.
> I'm reading a biography of Churchill at the moment, but it isn't in my hands right now.
> The company is hiring engineers this quarter.
We use present simple to stress that something is normal and fixed: **The museum opens at nine.** We use present continuous to say that things are not as usual: **The museum is opening late this week because of the renovation.**

## Changing and developing situations
For processes that are happening now and changing the picture, we use continuous, often with **get, become, grow, rise, fall, increase, improve, change**.
> The climate is changing faster than models predicted.
> Her English is getting better every week.
Compare: **Water boils at 100 °C** (a law of nature, simple) and **The water is boiling - turn the gas down** (a process happening now, continuous).

## Stative verbs
Verbs that describe a state, not an action, are normally not used in the continuous: **know, believe, understand, belong, own, owe, need, prefer, mean, doubt, remember, seem, consist**.
- ~~I'm knowing the answer.~~ → I **know** the answer.
- ~~This flat is belonging to my aunt.~~ → This flat **belongs** to my aunt.
But many verbs have **two meanings**: a 'state' meaning (simple) and an 'action' meaning (continuous).
> I **think** it's too risky. (an opinion)
> I'm **thinking** about moving abroad. (a process in my mind)
> The soup **tastes** salty. / The chef **is tasting** the soup.
> She **has** two cars. / She **is having** lunch.
> I **see** your point. / I'm **seeing** my dentist on Friday.
> The bag **weighs** 20 kilos. / The porter **is weighing** the bag.

## be + being: behaviour, not character
With adjectives of character, **be being** shows that someone is **behaving** in a certain way at the moment (often not as they usually do).
> He is rude. (that is his nature)
> He's being rude. (he is behaving rudely now)
> You're being very helpful today.
This is only possible with adjectives that describe controllable behaviour: **careful, silly, stubborn, nice, difficult, polite**. It is impossible with **tall, old, blonde, Irish**: ~~She is being tall.~~

## Common mistakes
- ~~I'm not understanding this chapter.~~ → I **don't understand** this chapter.
- ~~She is liking jazz.~~ → She **likes** jazz.
- ~~Every summer the river is flooding the village.~~ → The river **floods** the village every summer. (repeated event)
structure:
## Формы
| | Утверждение | Отрицание | Вопрос |
|---|---|---|---|
| Present simple | She works. | She doesn't work. | Does she work? |
| Present continuous | She is working. | She isn't working. | Is she working? |
| be being | He is being silly. | He isn't being silly. | Is he being silly? |

## Простое или длительное: тонкости значения
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Present simple | постоянное, обычное, факт | He lives in Rome. |
| Present continuous | временное, в развитии | He's living in Rome (this year). |
| Present simple + stative verb | состояние | I think she's right. |
| Present continuous + dynamic meaning | процесс, действие | I'm thinking about her offer. |
| Present continuous + get / become | изменение | Things are getting easier. |
| be being + adjective | поведение сейчас | You're being unfair. |

## Глаголы с двумя значениями
| Глагол | Состояние (simple) | Действие (continuous) |
|---|---|---|
| think | I think he's late. (считаю) | I'm thinking it over. (обдумываю) |
| have | We have a cat. (владею) | We're having breakfast. (завтракаем) |
| see | I see what you mean. (понимаю) | I'm seeing a client. (встречаюсь) |
| taste | It tastes bitter. (на вкус) | He's tasting the wine. (пробует) |
| weigh | It weighs 2 kg. (весит) | She's weighing the flour. (взвешивает) |
| feel | The silk feels smooth. (на ощупь) | He's feeling the wall. (ощупывает) |

exercises.title: Present simple или continuous?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в present simple или present continuous.
exercises.example: Sorry, I can't talk — I (have) lunch with a client. → I'm having lunch with a client.

items.text: Sorry, I can't talk now. We {{are having|'re having}} a heated discussion about the budget.
Do you know who {{owns}} that yacht in the harbour?
The sea level {{is rising|'s rising|rises}} steadily, and scientists {{believe}} the trend will continue.
He {{is being|'s being}} very cooperative this week, which isn't like him.
This soup {{tastes}} wonderful. What did you put in it?
The chef {{is tasting|'s tasting}} the sauce to check the seasoning.
I {{am thinking|'m thinking}} of changing my job, but I haven't decided yet.
Prices {{are getting|'re getting}} higher every month.

exercises.title: Два значения одного глагола
exercises.instruction: Вставьте глагол из скобок в подходящей форме: present simple или present continuous.

items.text: I {{see|can see}} what you mean, but I {{don't agree|do not agree}}.
Rumour has it that Jenna {{is seeing|'s seeing}} her boss's brother.
The baggage handler {{is weighing|'s weighing}} my suitcase right now.
The doctor {{is feeling|'s feeling}} the patient's pulse.
My brother {{has|has got|'s got}} a house in Lisbon.
We {{are having|'re having}} trouble with our neighbours at the moment.

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, который лучше всего подходит по смыслу.

items.q: Whenever I ___ the news, I feel anxious.
items.why: Повторяющееся событие (whenever) — **present simple**; will в придаточном времени не ставится.

items.q: Unemployment ___ at the moment, according to the latest figures.
items.why: Процесс, происходящий в данный период (at the moment), — **present continuous**.

items.q: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
I ___ you're right, although I haven't checked the numbers.
items.why: Мнение, а не процесс: **think** в значении «считать» — глагол состояния.

items.q: Be quiet, please — I ___ about the answer.
items.why: Мыслительный процесс в данный момент — **am thinking**.

items.q: This bag ___ more than I expected.
items.why: Weigh в значении «весить» — состояние, continuous не нужен.

items.q: I can't talk — I ___ dinner with a client right now.
She ___ the sea air; it reminds her of childhood.
items.why: Love в обычном значении — глагол состояния, **loves**.

options: My uncle is owning three restaurants.
items.why: Own — глагол состояния, continuous не используется.

options: What are you thinking of the new manager?
What do you think of the new manager?
items.why: Вопрос о мнении — **do you think**; are you thinking спрашивает о процессе: What are you thinking about?

options: The river floods the valley every spring.
The river is flooding the valley every spring.
She is being tall for her age.
She is tall for her age.
items.why: Be being возможно только с прилагательными, описывающими управляемое поведение; tall — не такое.

options: Why are you being so secretive today?
Why do you being so secretive today?
items.why: Поведение сейчас: **are you being**; do you being — грамматически невозможно.
Smell в значении «пахнуть» — состояние, continuous не используется.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов, поставив глагол в present simple или present continuous. Добавьте нужные слова.

answers: She is currently working on a documentary.
She's currently working on a documentary.

items.prompt: (this museum / open / at nine every day)
answers: This museum opens at nine every day.

items.prompt: (the population of the city / grow / rapidly)
answers: The population of the city is growing rapidly.
The population of the city grows rapidly.

items.prompt: (I / not / belong / to any political party)
answers: I don't belong to any political party.
I do not belong to any political party.
Why are you being so evasive today?

items.prompt: (the soup / taste / better / when / you / add / more salt)
answers: The soup tastes better when you add more salt.

exercises.title: Перепишите, подчеркнув временность
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение так, чтобы показать, что ситуация временная. Используйте present continuous и слова в скобках.

items.prompt: My parents live in a flat in the centre. (until their house is ready)
answers: My parents are living in a flat in the centre until their house is ready.
My parents are living in a flat in the centre, until their house is ready.
Until their house is ready, my parents are living in a flat in the centre.
Until their house is ready my parents are living in a flat in the centre.
He is working from home this month.
He's working from home this month.
This month he is working from home.
This month he's working from home.
This month, he is working from home.
This month, he's working from home.

items.prompt: They don't use the old entrance. (at the moment)
answers: They aren't using the old entrance at the moment.
They are not using the old entrance at the moment.
They're not using the old entrance at the moment.
At the moment they aren't using the old entrance.
At the moment they are not using the old entrance.
At the moment they're not using the old entrance.
At the moment, they aren't using the old entrance.
At the moment, they are not using the old entrance.
At the moment, they're not using the old entrance.

items.prompt: Do you drive to work? (this week)
answers: Are you driving to work this week?

items.prompt: She teaches a course on migration. (this term)
answers: She is teaching a course on migration this term.
She's teaching a course on migration this term.
This term she is teaching a course on migration.
This term she's teaching a course on migration.
This term, she is teaching a course on migration.
This term, she's teaching a course on migration.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте на вопросы полными предложениями на английском. Используйте present simple и present continuous.

items.prompt: What are you reading or studying at the moment?
items.sample: I'm reading a novel about the Silk Road, and I'm studying English every evening.

items.prompt: Describe something in your city that is changing.
items.sample: My city is getting more crowded, and new apartment blocks are appearing everywhere.

items.prompt: What do you usually do on weekends, and what is different this weekend?
items.sample: I usually visit my parents, but this weekend I'm working on a project.

items.prompt: Name a verb that has two meanings (think, have, see...) and use it in both ways.
items.sample: I think it's a good idea, but I'm thinking about the risks.

items.prompt: Describe a time when someone is being unusually kind or difficult.
items.sample: My colleague is being unusually helpful this week, probably because he wants a favour.
